svg.aria-label: Animation: solving the four queens problem by placing queens and backtracking from dead ends
svg.title: Animation: solving the four queens problem by placing queens and backtracking from dead ends
svg.text: Try, fail, undo, try the next - and never revisit a branch you have disproved

text.tspan: try a choice, recurse, and the moment it cannot work, undo it and try the next - pruning whole

g.text: place a queen in row 0. Any column will do for now - pick the first.
row 1: columns 0 and 1 are attacked, so the first legal square is column 2

text.tspan: row 2: every column is attacked. Dead end - abandon this branch without exploring it

g.text: backtrack one level: undo row 1 and try its next legal column instead
row 2 has exactly one legal square, but then row 3 has none. Dead end again.

text.tspan: every branch under row 0 = column 0 has now failed, so backtrack all the way and move the
from column 1 the search completes: all four queens stand safely. Backtracking = DFS that
brute force explores every arrangement. Backtracking abandons a branch the instant it becomes
illegal, which is what makes it tractable.
